predictor.title: H-index Predictor
predictor.subtitle: Project when you'll hit your target H-index based on citation growth and publication rate.
predictor.noPapersWarning: This researcher has no tracked papers yet, so this projection is based purely on new papers you plan to publish — it won't reflect any existing body of work. Look up a researcher with papers, or use demo data, for a more realistic projection.
predictor.targetTooLow: Target should be higher than your current H-index ({{current}}).
predictor.venueTooltip: Sets a multiplier on how fast NEW papers you publish going forward earn citations — Top venue (3x) and Strong venue (2x) speed up the projection, Emerging venue (0.5x) slows it down. It does not change citations on papers you've already published.
predictor.venueHint: A rough heuristic, not a real impact-factor database — only affects how fast new papers you publish going forward accumulate citations.
predictor.saveLoginRequired: Log in and look up a real researcher to save predictions.
predictor.notReachedTitle: Not reachable within 20 years at this rate
predictor.notReachedDesc: Try increasing citation growth or publication rate.
predictor.digestLabel: Email me weekly progress updates toward this goal
predictor.digestOnMessage: You're subscribed to weekly progress emails.
predictor.digestOffMessage: You've unsubscribed from weekly progress emails.
predictor.digestFailed: Couldn't update your email preference. Please try again.
predictor.realCurveHint: Applied per paper using a realistic citation curve based on its publish year — new papers start slow, peak around year 2-4, then taper off.

verify.title: Verify academic information
verify.subtitle: Enter an ORCID iD and whatever you claim about yourself (H-index, paper count, citations...) — this checks it against Semantic Scholar first, falling back to OpenAlex only if Semantic Scholar has no record, and shows you exactly where the numbers agree or don't.
verify.loginRequired: Log in to run and save a verification.
verify.submitFailed: Couldn't run verification. Please try again.
verify.invalidOrcid: That doesn't look like a valid ORCID iD. Expected format: 0000-0002-1825-0097.
verify.notFound: No record found for this ORCID in Semantic Scholar or OpenAlex.
verify.historyEmpty: No past verification runs for this ORCID yet.
verify.ownerNote: Confirmed by the ORCID owner on {{date}} — shown instead of the raw Semantic Scholar/OpenAlex snapshot.
verify.ownerSubmitSuccess: Saved as your ORCID-confirmed record — this now shows as the confirmed value for anyone who looks up this ORCID.
verify.ownerCorrectionHint: These numbers come from Semantic Scholar/OpenAlex and may be out of date. If this is your ORCID, sign in with "Continue with ORCID" (matching this iD) and submit your real numbers above — once confirmed, they'll replace these as your official record.
verify.comparisonSourceNote: Compares what you claimed against the raw Semantic Scholar/OpenAlex snapshot — independent of any ORCID-owner-confirmed record above.

frontier.subtitle: See exactly which papers are closest to raising your h-index — not just the current number.

frontier.summarySingle_other: Your next milestone is h = {{next}}. Your closest candidate, "{{title}}", needs {{count}} more citations to get there.
frontier.summaryMultiple_one: Reaching h = {{next}} requires {{count}} more paper to cross its citation threshold — see below.
frontier.summaryMultiple_other: Reaching h = {{next}} requires {{count}} more papers to cross that citation threshold — see below.
frontier.newWorkNeeded_one: Even after your existing papers catch up, {{count}} additional new publication would still be needed to reach h = {{next}}.
frontier.newWorkNeeded_other: Even after your existing papers catch up, {{count}} additional new publications would still be needed to reach h = {{next}}.
frontier.disclaimer: Based on your {{h}} tracked papers and their current citation counts — recalculates automatically as citations and papers update.
